newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Allstate estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Allstate estimate raised.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Peter Wade raised his fourth quarter earnings per share estimate on Allstate Corp to $1.15 from $1.03, boosting his full-year 1996 estimate to $3.57 from $3.45.
-- The change is to more fully reflect the improved earnings of the company owing to restructurings, the analyst said in a summary report.
-- "We believe Allstate is likely to beat the Street's estimate of $1.11 in the fourth quarter," he said.
